{{Youmay|a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model made by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]|an [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] [[Dactyl|compound]] found on [[Cona/Legends|Cona]]}}
The '''Dactyl''' was a model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. One was once used by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Zekk]] and [[Jagged Fel]] during their hunt for [[Alema Rar]].

Though far less maneuverable than a [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]], the Dactyl contained at least enough room for three private berths for crew members and enough space to store [[StealthX wing|StealthXs]]. It was also equipped with two observation blisters, both several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] apart on opposite sides of the fuselage, and an intercom.
